name: Nils Ušakovs - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2027 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out what it wants in the European Union's 2027 budget, the last year of the current seven-year spending plan. It asks for money for jobs, skills, affordable housing, health, research, clean energy, farming, border security and defence, and continued support for Ukraine. It also wants EU money to keep going only to countries that respect the rule of law. This is the Parliament's position, not a final budget.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament states its spending priorities for 2027.
- **Who it affects:** Everyone in the EU, plus farmers, students, regions and Ukraine.
- **What happens next:** Talks with EU governments, then a final budget deal.
